title: SDS-PAGE protein gel
summary: Denaturing protein gel that separates by molecular weight. Foundational step before Western blot.
hazardsMd: β-mercaptoethanol is foul-smelling and irritating. Add inside a fume hood. SDS dust is irritating; wear a mask when weighing.
contentUndergrad:
## How SDS-PAGE works
SDS coats proteins with negative charge proportional to length, masking native charge. They migrate by size through a polyacrylamide mesh.

steps.title: Prepare samples
steps.instructionMd: Mix sample with 4× Laemmli sample buffer + reducer to 1× final. Heat 95 °C / 5 min. Spin briefly. Load 5-30 μg per well.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Add β-mercaptoethanol to Laemmli inside the fume hood; aliquot after.
steps.verificationMd: Samples are blue from the dye, clear (no precipitate). Volume calculated to fit in well (~15-25 μL for mini gel).

steps.title: Set up the gel
steps.instructionMd: Insert pre-cast gel in tank. Fill inner reservoir to overflow with running buffer (this seals the wells). Fill outer reservoir to the marked line.
steps.verificationMd: No bubbles trapped under wells. Outer buffer at the proper line.

steps.title: Load and run
steps.instructionMd: Pipette samples slowly to the bottom of each well. Always include a pre-stained ladder lane. Run at 200 V (constant) for ~35 min until dye reaches the bottom.
steps.verificationMd: Dye front migrates uniformly across the gel. Pre-stained ladder bands visibly separate.

steps.title: Stain with Coomassie
steps.instructionMd: Transfer gel to a tray with InstantBlue (or 0.1% Coomassie in 40% methanol/10% acetic acid). Rock 30 min. Destain in water until background clears.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Coomassie methanol/acetic acid stain is hazardous waste; collect destain water in a labeled container.
steps.verificationMd: Bands visible against pale background. No streaking down lanes.

steps.title: Image the gel
steps.instructionMd: Capture with a flatbed scanner or gel imager (white-light mode). Save TIFF for downstream densitometry.
steps.verificationMd: Image has visible bands without saturation. Ladder bands match expected MW.
